SELECT 
  ml.lot_id,
  ml.lot_number,
  ml.item_id,
  ml.supplier_id,
  ml.received_quantity,
  ml.remaining_quantity,
  ml.unit_of_measure,
  ml.current_location_id,

JOIN inventory_items ii ON ml.item_id = ii.item_id

WHERE lmt.batch_id = 'RUN-20261011-90001'

LIMIT 1000
